metadata.description:
What really happens inside your body when you fast for 36 hours? In this science-based animated journey, you will travel inside the human body and watch your organs react in real time — from glycogen depletion to ketosis, fat burning, and autophagy.
Follow Elisa as she consults Dr. Jo Jo and discovers how her brain, liver, pancreas, heart, kidneys, lungs, and stomach adapt during prolonged fasting. This video explains complex biology in a simple, visual, and entertaining way while also highlighting the benefits, risks, and safety precautions of extended fasting. 

You will learn:
• What happens during the first 6, 12, 24, and 36 hours of fasting
• When your body switches from glucose to fat burning
• How ketosis fuels your brain with clean energy
• What autophagy is and how it cleans damaged cells
• How fasting affects insulin, inflammation, and metabolism
• Which organs benefit most during fasting
• Who should NEVER attempt extended fasting without medical advice
• How to safely break a fast
This educational animation is based on real human physiology and is designed to help you understand your body better before attempting fasting.


⚠️ Medical Disclaimer: This video is for educational purposes only. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before attempting extended fasting.
